_note: Hand-authored brief. Mechanism: a person applying a system with total sincerity to something that does not need one. The joke is escalation of bureaucracy onto an object that cannot spoil, ending on the system eating itself.

premise.situation: A man in the office puts masking-tape dates on every item in the shared fridge
premise.turn: He ends up dating things that cannot expire, and finally the fridge itself
premise.detail: a date written on a jar of mustard

character_sheet: a man in his late thirties, thinning hair, tucked-in polo shirt, lanyard

beats.text: There is a man at my office who puts dates on the fridge.
Not his name on the tape. The date. Every container, same handwriting.
Last Tuesday I found a date on a jar of mustard.
Mustard does not expire. Mustard will outlive this building.
I asked him about it and he got out his phone and showed me a photo of the shelf.
He said, and I am quoting him exactly, we needed a baseline.
There is now a date on the fridge.
